title: Completed torrents not being removed from qBittorrent according to global seed ratio config in some edge-cases (bad floating point arithmetic)
author: MMauro94

comments.author: bakerboy448
comments.body:
> qBittorrent rounds of its ratio when deciding to pause a torrent, but then provides in its API response a full double which we store as float. When a paused torrent is then Global Max ratio it can be under the ratio (`0.99999 < 1`) which results in a paused torrent not being removed even though it is presented in qbit ui as Paused with a ratio of 1.0
> 
> By rounding off the seeded ratio when checking for removal candidates we can avoid these edge cases hanging in qbit.

https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/pull/6376

From the commit

comments.author: MMauro94
comments.body:
Ah I see, thanks for the quick response. In that case, shouldn't [this line](https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/develop/src/NzbDrone.Core/Download/Clients/QBittorrent/QBittorrent.cs#L633) have been changed accordingly as well? I'm assuming qBittorrent does the rounding regardless of whether the max seed ratio is set at the config level or at the torrent level.

----

Regardless, the bug with `1.1` and other similar edge-cases remains. My suggestion would be to do something similar to this:

```c#
torrent.Ratio >= config.MaxRatio || Math.Abs(torrent.Ratio - config.MaxRatio) <= 0.01f
```

This should work as expected: https://www.programiz.com/online-compiler/693pfx6Fcip9J
